flights.cabin: Economy (1 stop via LAS • Airbus A321neo)
flights.notes: Cheapest flight ($235). Nonstop direct available at $619.

gotchas: Unbundled fare means overhead carry-on and seat selection cost extra
Tight 30-minute layover in Las Vegas (LAS) leaves zero room for delays
Winter holiday travel through LAS carries minor desert fog/operational risks
positive_highlights: 2.2nd percentile historical price represents an extreme absolute bottom
Saves approximately $221 compared to the seasonal median for Christmas/New Year week
Flies modern Airbus A321neo equipment rather than a cramped regional jet
audit.rationale: At the 2.2nd historical percentile during peak Christmas week, this $235 fare is an unprecedented steal that will not drop further. Lock it in immediately, but travel light with just a personal item to avoid ancillary baggage fees.

flights.cabin: Economy (1 stop via LAS • Airbus A320neo)
flights.notes: Cheapest flight ($301). Nonstop direct available at $619.

audit.baggage_status: $45+ Carry-on & Checked Bag Fees (Frontier Basic Economy)
gotchas: Unbundled fare means overhead carry-on and checked bags cost extra, easily erasing any base fare savings
Tight 30-minute connection in LAS (Las Vegas) leaves zero room for winter delay recovery
Airbus A320neo operated by Frontier Airlines with a total travel time of over 6 hours for a domestic transcontinental route
positive_highlights: Covers the peak Christmas-to-New-Year holiday window (Dec 23 - Jan 6) without massive price inflation
Direct routing through LAS avoids notorious winter weather hubs like DEN or ORD
audit.rationale: At the 44.4th percentile for the Christmas travel window, this $301 fare is acceptable only if you travel strictly with a personal item. Factoring in Frontier's mandatory bag and seat fees quickly diminishes the value compared to legacy carriers.

flights.notes: SkyWest CRJ-900 regional service. Nonstop 55-minute hop. Roller bags get pink gate-checked.

gotchas: Regional jet (CRJ-900) operations mean standard-sized roller bags frequently require complimentary gate-side pink-tag valeting due to limited overhead bin space.
Holiday Semester Break window (late December to early January) experiences heightened airport congestion and peak seasonal demand.
positive_highlights: Priced in the 14.4th historical percentile, delivering an estimated $67 in savings versus the seasonal median.
Nonstop direct routing on Delta Connection (SkyWest) with a swift 57-minute flight duration.
Main Cabin ticket includes standard carry-on baggage without unbundled surprise fees.
audit.rationale: At the 14.4th historical percentile for peak holiday travel, this sub-$210 nonstop fare represents an exceptional value that will not drop further. Secure this ticket immediately before holiday inventory sells out.

gotchas: 2-stop routing via BNA increases total travel time to 6h 45m

flights.notes: Quick ski escape to Summit County / Winter Park via Denver. Winter weather connection caution at DEN.

audit.baggage_status: 2 Free Checked Bags & Free Overhead Carry-on Included
gotchas: Ski travel over the MLK holiday weekend carries high seasonal demand
Evening departure time risks minor rolling delays
positive_highlights: Nonstop direct flight on Boeing 737MAX 8
Southwest includes two free checked bags (huge value for ski gear)
No change or cancellation fees
audit.rationale: Even though the quoted price sits in the upper historical quartile, MLK weekend ski flights to Denver rarely drop lower and airlines are pricing peak demand aggressively. Securing this nonstop itinerary with Southwest's generous baggage policy guarantees hassle-free holiday travel.
